service.name: Eureka Orthos (Deep Dungeon)
service.longDescription: Beneath the Crystal Tower in Mor Dhona, the Allagan Empire’s deepest secrets slumber. Eureka Orthos descends into a research facility abandoned for millennia — a hundred floors of Allagan horrors waiting beneath the syndicate’s watchful eye.

rewards.title: Aetherpool Levels & Armour
rewards.text: Upgrades on your Aetherpool Level & Armour.

rewards.title: Once and Future King/Queen Title
rewards.text: Exclusive title achieved by completing the deep dungeon solo.

rewards.title: Achievement: “All by Eurekaself II”
rewards.text: Achievement unlocked upon clearing Eureka Orthos Floor 100 Solo.
